 Follow Roku Quietly Adds Five More Free Channels
 Matt Hladik Tue, November 10, 2026 at 4:43 PM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Roku Quietly Adds Five More Free Channels Roku has been consistently adding free channels to its library throughout 2026, with more than 500 options now available through The Roku Channel, the company's free, ad-supported streaming service.
 This week, five more channels were added, per Cord Cutters News , covering the genres of true crime, science fiction, sports and more.
 What are the five newest free channels Roku added?
 Channel 2687 – The Oxygen Murders of America
 Channel 5120 – Mutant X
 Channel 5121 – Todo Familia
 Channel 620 – AYM Sports 3
 Channel 1521 – Outlaw
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Oxygen Murders of America focuses on homicide investigations, including cold cases, and serial killer profiles and documentaries. Mutant X, meanwhile, features the early 2000s science-fiction series based on a group of genetically modified humans with special powers.
 Todo Familia is a avenue for Spanish language content, while AYM Sports 3 will cover various Mexican and Latin American sports, including baseball and soccer.
 Finally, Outlaw is focused on westerns, both classic and more modern.
 "The channels remain available indefinitely as part of the existing free guide, consistent with Roku's ongoing practice of adding specialized linear options that require no extra cost beyond the device itself," says Cord Cutters News' Luke Bouma. "The expansion continues the service's effort to increase specialized free content across true crime, science fiction, family programming, sports, and western genres for households that rely on streaming devices."
